# EDO-TOKYO MUSEUM

> > The EDO-TOKYO MUSEUM preserves and presents the history and culture of Tokyo from the Edo period to modern times through exhibitions, educational programs, and cultural initiatives.

The museum offers comprehensive educational resources including the Edohaku Culture program and Mobile Edo-Tokyo Museum, bringing historical artifacts and learning experiences to diverse audiences. Located in Tokyo, the museum serves as a vital institution for understanding the transformation of Japan's capital city across centuries.
